title: How To Start Journaling
caption:
Five steps to start a journaling habit that sticks.

Save this for tomorrow morning.

Most people quit journaling because they treat it like a school assignment. The trick is to make the entry small enough that you can't fail.

Follow @yourbrand for daily habits.

#journaling #habits #productivity

body: Tie the entry to a moment, not a feeling.
